(NYSE: FLO) today announced that its board of directors has elected Shaun P. Mara and Ken Plunk as independent directors, effective Nov. 18, 2026. The board appointed Mara and Plunk to serve on the audit and finance committees. With the election of the two new directors, the size of the board will increase to 10 members. “We are pleased to welcome Shaun and Ken to the Flowers Foods board,” said Ryals McMullian, chairman and chief executive officer. “Each brings extensive leadership experience and a distinct perspective. Their broad financial and transformation experience will be valuable as we continue to strengthen our portfolio, sharpen execution, and transform Flowers for future growth.” Mara is an experienced financial executive and strategic adviser with more than three decades of consumer products experience. He retired in June 2025 as chief financial officer of The Simply Good Foods Company, where he helped guide the company’s growth, acquisitions, and integration of the Quest brand following its public-market launch. He previously held chief financial officer roles at Dean Foods, Teasdale Latin Foods, and Roofing Supply Group and served in senior financial leadership roles at William Wrigley Jr. Company and Gillette. Mara previously served on the board of Farmer Bros. Co. and chaired its audit committee. Plunk is an accomplished public company chief financial officer with broad experience across consumer packaged goods, retail, manufacturing, and international operations. He previously served as chief financial officer and senior vice president of information technology at J&J Snack Foods, where he helped shape financial strategy, capital investment, supply chain expansion and acquisition activity. Earlier in his career, Plunk held senior finance and audit leadership roles at Walmart and worked at The Coca-Cola Company and The Home Depot. He currently serves on the boards of WD-40 Company and Milo’s Tea Company, with committee responsibilities spanning audit, finance, risk, and governance. About Flowers Foods Headquartered in Thomasville, Ga., Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE: FLO) is one of the largest producers of packaged bakery foods in the United States with 2025 sales of $5.3 billion. Flowers operates bakeries across the country that produce a wide range of bakery products. Among the company’s top brands are Nature’s Own, Dave’s Killer Bread, Canyon Bakehouse, Simple Mills, Wonder, and Tastykake . Learn more at www.flowersfoods.com .
